verdict.rationale: PayPal explicitly documents downloadable/importable OpenAPI specs: 'Explore our REST API descriptions, generate code for your API clients, and import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools' and provides a GitHub repo (paypal-rest-api-specifications) with actual OpenAPI JSON files used for codegen. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of spec completeness/versioning outside PayPal's own repo.
